column1: A larger version of the A-{n} with {n} greater storage capacity and advanced weight redistribution technology.
column2: A-{n}的放大型，储存容量增加{n}，并采用先进的重量再分配技术。

column1: A larger version of the R-{n} with twice the storage capacity as well as the ability to begin the recycling process while en route to the recycling unit.
column2: R-{n}的放大型，储存容量翻倍，还能在前往回收站途中开始回收。

column1: S-{n} Plague design is completely centered around its heavy machine gun. With a good chance to sustain at least one direct hit to the core, a group of S-{n}s can perforate most targets before suffering heavy losses. Powerful explosives are the only way to easily overcome an S-{n} squad.
column2: S-{n}瘟疫型完全围绕重机枪设计。它们很可能至少承受一次核心直击；一群S-{n}能在惨重损失前打穿多数目标。只有强力爆炸物才能轻松击溃S-{n}小队。

column1: G-{n} Soldiers are each equipped with a heavy laser, a significant upgrade from its predecessor the G-{n} but like the G-{n} are prone to overheating. Also still somewhat weak against electromagnetic attacks.
column2: G-{n}士兵均配备重型激光器，较前代G-{n}大幅强化，但与G-{n}一样容易过热，也仍较怕电磁攻击。

column1: B-{n} Gladiators are better armored than the B-{n} replace the hammer with a slightly more damaging mace, and like other B-series brawlers are only dispatched in coordination with grunts.
column2: B-{n}角斗士装甲优于B-{n}，以伤害稍高的钉头锤替代战锤；与其他B系斗士一样，只会配合步兵出击。

column1: L-{n} Fighters are even more accurate than the L-{n} and use an axe for slightly improved slashing force. Like other L-series robots, the L-{n} is only dispatched in coordination with grunts. Like other L-series robots, the L-{n}'s armor structure is reinforced against the slashes of melee damage, as well as piercing attacks.
column2: L-{n}战士比L-{n}更精准，并使用斧头提升劈砍力。与其他L系机器人一样，L-{n}只会配合步兵出击；L-{n}的装甲结构可抵御近战劈砍和穿刺攻击。

column1: The I-{n} Angel's remote force field is {n} more effective than the I-{n}'s shield generator, shielding targets from half of all damage where there is enough energy to support the field. Protector class robots are not especially well armored, but in addition to their shield are also strong against more common thermal weaponry, as well as always working in concert with a larger assault force.
column2: I-{n}天使的远程力场比I-{n}护盾发生器强{n}，能在能量充足时为目标抵消一半伤害。守护者装甲不算坚固，但有护盾且擅长抵御常见热武器，并始终协同大型突击部队行动。

column1: I-{n} Archangels are equipped with a more efficient force field than the I-{n} and greater battery storage to support its use. Their point defense system further conserves energy by intercepting explosive projectiles prior to detonation.
column2: I-{n}大天使配备比I-{n}更高效的力场及更大电池，以支持力场运作。其点防御系统还能拦截爆炸弹体，在引爆前将其摧毁以节省能量。

column1: A better-armored version of the Y-{n} with upgraded weaponry. Like other Y-class robots, their large size is a primary drawback, as it makes them easier to hit both when targeted and by stray projectiles.
column2: Y-{n}的强化装甲与武器升级版。和其他Y系机器人一样，体型庞大是其主要弱点：无论被瞄准还是遭流弹命中，都更容易中弹。

column1: The original C-{n} design was focused on passive analysis and rudimentary heavy lifting since I handled most of the fundamental generative work, though later derelict derivations encountered in the {n}b1 caves have demonstrated an increasingly creative streak. I might need to sweep the caves clear of them to avoid an eventual tech race. After harvesting their knowledge, of course.
column2: 最初的C-{n}设计侧重被动分析和基础搬运，因为基础生成工作都由我负责。但在{n}b1洞穴发现的后续遗弃衍生型越来越有创造性。我或许得清剿洞穴，免得最终形成技术竞赛。当然，要先收割它们的知识。
